svg.title: BREACH.EXE: an animated hacker game where vulnerabilities fall and are patched
svg.desc: Animated game banner. SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, RCE, CSRF, BOLA, JWT, XXE, LFI, auth bypass and privilege escalation fall toward a perimeter firewall while a shield turret destroys each one.

g.text: every threat that falls is one you already know how to stop
